name: Wesley Hunt

accounts.evidence: His official House website links to x.com/RepWPH as its X account.
A FOX 26 Houston article links two posts by Hunt from the WesleyHuntTX account during his 2026 Senate primary dispute with the Cornyn campaign.

notes: The handle on file, RepWesleyHunt, appears to have been replaced by RepWPH (as linked from hunt.house.gov). WesleyHuntTX is his personal/political account; it may also have served as his Senate campaign account. I did not find a separate campaign website.

name: Emily Randall

accounts.evidence: Her campaign website's Twitter icon links to electemilyrandall.com/twitter, which redirects to twitter.com/emilyrandallwa.

notes: Her official House website (randall.house.gov) links Facebook, Instagram, Bluesky and YouTube but no X account, so no official X account was found. The handle came from the campaign site's /twitter redirect (checked with an HTTP header request); the campaign site may date from her 2024 run, but the redirect was live on 14 November 2026.

name: Jerry Carl

notes: A search result summary said ProPublica Politwoops lists RepJerryCarl as his former official House account (2021-2025), but the Politwoops page I opened did not show the handles, so it is not included. A new official account will probably be created after he is sworn in. I could not open his Ballotpedia page (blocked) and did not find a separate campaign website.
